name: protein kinase D2
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PRKD2 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase D2. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Polymorphous adenocarcinoma; Cribriform adenocarcinoma of salivary gland. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
